title: Prophet, Priest, and King
definition: Prophet, Priest, and King describes the threefold office of Christ: He reveals God's truth, intercedes and sacrifices for His people, and reigns as Lord.
summary: Jesus is the final Prophet, perfect Priest, and reigning King.
christFocus: Christ reveals God, reconciles sinners, and rules His people with perfect wisdom, mercy, and authority.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture reveals Christ as Prophet, Priest, and King. As Prophet, He speaks God's truth fully and finally. He does not merely bring information from God; He reveals God Himself.

As Priest, Jesus offers the perfect sacrifice and intercedes for His people. Unlike earthly priests who offered repeated sacrifices, Christ offered Himself once for all and lives to intercede.

As King, Jesus reigns with all authority. His kingdom is not built by worldly power but by truth, righteousness, redemption, and final victory. He rules over His church now and will openly reign over all things.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often reduce Jesus to only one part of His work: teacher, comforter, Savior, or example. This doctrine matters because believers need the whole Christ: His truth for confusion, His sacrifice for guilt, His intercession for weakness, and His rule for obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Listen to Christ as Prophet, draw near through Him as Priest, and submit to Him as King. Let His complete ministry shape your doctrine, your prayer life, your confidence, and your obedience.
